links.comparator_used: Ungated generation without schema and SNOMED ontology validation
links.outcome: Share of synthetic records rejected for schema or ontology failures (filter attribution)
links.effect: Schema validation rejected 148 of 512 records in the fully gated corpus; ontology grounding rejected a further 24. Ungated, 29.9% of records had schema failures.
links.quote: Schema validation is the load-bearing filter: within the fully gated corpus it rejects 148 of 512 records, ontology grounding a further 24, and staging-logic validation none---the only generator producing logic violations is already excluded on schema, making clinical-logic validation a generator-conditional safeguard rather than the dominant filter.

links.outcome: Gate compliance of generated synthetic records, per generator
links.effect: Improved gate compliance by 12.5 percentage points for one generator, had no measurable effect for a second, and collapsed output in a third.
links.tradeoff: Output collapse in one generator; the effect is strongly model-dependent, so retrieval needs per-model evaluation.
links.quote: Retrieval augmentation is strongly model-dependent: it improves gate compliance for one generator by 12.5 percentage points, has no measurable effect for a second, and collapses output in a third.

design_hint: symbolic validation gate and retrieval augmentation for synthetic data generation
